Package com.irurueta.units

Class PressureConverter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.units.PressureConverter
public final class PressureConverter extends Object
Does pressure conversions to different units. To prevent loss of accuracy, conversion should only be done as a final step before displaying pressure measurements.
